rowdata.PropertiesValue: "SELECT count(distinct(claimno)) as \"IsDLA\",SUM (os_value) AS \"DLAShare\",SUM (aksep_value) AS \"KlaimAmount\",(SELECT note FROM pooldata.businessgroup WHERE id = a.businessgroupid) as \"Country\", to_char(dateofloss,'dd/mm/yyyy') as \"DLAType\",col_desc as \"Currency\", businessgroupid as \"IsKirim\", (select KURSVALUE from POOLDATA.MST_XOL_PNC t where ID='"+Param.IDMASTER+"') as \"DISC\" FROM pooldata.t_claim_xol a WHERE TO_CHAR (a.dateofloss, 'dd/mm/yyyy') ='"+Param.DOL+"' and A.COL_DESC='"+Param.causeofloss+"' AND a.businessgroupid IN (select J.IDBUSINESS from POOLDATA.MST_XOL_BUSINESS j where ID in (select c.id from POOLDATA.MST_XOL_PNC c where TAHUN='"+GetTempXOL.AlasanKlaim+"')) GROUP BY TO_CHAR (dateofloss, 'dd/mm/yyyy'), col_desc,a.businessgroupid"

rowdata.PropertiesValue: "SELECT COUNT (distinct(A.COMPANYNAME)) AS \"IsDLA\", SUM (TO_NUMBER (REPLACE (REPLACE (CLAIMAMOUNT, '.', ''), ',', '.'))*POOLDATA.GETCURRENCYSTANDARD(A.CURRENCYID,to_date(A.DATEOFLOSS,'dd/mm/yyyy'))/POOLDATA.GETCURRENCYSTANDARD('10001',to_date(A.DATEOFLOSS,'dd/mm/yyyy')))AS \"DLAShare\",SUM (TO_NUMBER (REPLACE (REPLACE (PAIDCLAIMAMOUNTSHARE, '.', ''), ',', '.'))*POOLDATA.GETCURRENCYSTANDARD(A.CURRENCYID,to_date(A.DATEOFLOSS,'dd/mm/yyyy'))/POOLDATA.GETCURRENCYSTANDARD('10001',to_date(A.DATEOFLOSS,'dd/mm/yyyy'))) AS \"KlaimAmount\",'Treaty Inward' AS \"Country\",a.DATEOFLOSS AS \"DLAType\" FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_INWARD_XOL a WHERE TO_CHAR (TO_DATE (a.dateofloss, 'dd/mm/yyyy'),'dd/mm/yyyy') = '"+Param.DOL+"' AND A.CAUSEOFLOSS = '"+Param.causeofloss+"' group by dateofloss"
